We are doing the same thing, building ourselves into a corner with modern finance based economies, where resources are burnt to generate revenue with no money put into either blue sky research or even efficiency research. We could very easily collapse our entire civilization in this way, not to mention that living in a world where you're rich as fuck but have nothing of value to spend the money on is kind of the definition of pointless.
